products.name: Epic AI (SlicerDicer, etc.)
products.note: Clinical decision support; patient data exposure; HIPAA critical; FDA SaMD considerations

profile_text.body:
Epic Systems is a healthcare software company founded in 1979, originally operating out of a basement. The company describes itself as developing software to help people get well, stay well, and help future generations be healthier, with the patient positioned at the center of its work.

On the AI front, Epic offers a suite of AI-supported tools grouped under its Epic AI offering, which includes products such as SlicerDicer and a feature called Chart with Art, an AI charting tool for clinical documentation. The company describes AI-supported outpatient office visits that help clinicians arrive prepared, anticipate needs during the appointment, and complete documentation and orders before the visit ends. Nurses at Mount Sinai Medical Center are noted on the site as the first in Florida to adopt Chart with Art for nursing documentation.

The site's held facts flag Epic AI as falling within the Healthcare and Life Sciences AI category, with noted considerations around clinical decision support, patient data exposure, HIPAA compliance, and FDA Software as a Medical Device classifications. No litigation or regulatory filings are currently recorded against the company in the held facts.
